security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives from Markdown code fences and inline file references, and the anti-pattern headings are not system reconnaissance. The three Python scripts write JSON output to a user-supplied path, which is a real but limited filesystem overwrite risk. No prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or malicious business logic was found.

remediation.issue: User-controlled output paths can overwrite arbitrary files when script output is enabled.
remediation.suggestion: Restrict output paths to the project directory, create parent directories safely, and require an explicit force option before overwriting existing files.

remediation.issue: The documentation includes deployment command examples that can affect live infrastructure if copied without review.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear preflight checks and confirmation guidance before Docker, Compose, or Kubernetes examples.

content.value_statement: Fullstack projects need clear stack choices, workflows, and quality gates before implementation starts. This skill provides practical guidance, reference checklists, and lightweight scripts for planning and review.
actual_capabilities: Provides stack guidance for React, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and related tools.
Documents high-level architecture patterns, development workflows, and anti-pattern sections.
Runs Python helper scripts against a target path to produce basic status and findings reports.
Can print JSON output or write a JSON report when the scripts are run with output options.
Lists common development, analysis, and deployment commands for project workflows.
limitations: The helper scripts currently perform basic path validation and report generation, not deep code analysis.
The scaffolding scripts do not generate a complete production application by themselves.
Reference documents are high-level templates and need project-specific decisions.
Deployment commands require human review before use in any real environment.

use_cases.title: Plan a new application stack
use_cases.description: Select a practical frontend, backend, database, and deployment direction before development starts.

use_cases.title: Prepare an architecture review
use_cases.description: Use the references to discuss patterns, risks, and tradeoffs with a team before implementation.

use_cases.title: Standardize project onboarding
use_cases.description: Create a shared workflow for setup, quality checks, troubleshooting, and common commands.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a starter stack
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me choose a fullstack stack for a small web application. Include frontend, backend, database, testing, and deployment choices.

prompt_templates.title: Review project setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate review of an existing repository
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my project structure using this skill. Identify missing setup steps, quality checks, documentation gaps, and workflow risks.

prompt_templates.title: Improve architecture decisions
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the architecture references to compare patterns for my application. Explain tradeoffs for scalability, maintainability, security, and delivery speed.

prompt_templates.title: Design a delivery workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a full delivery workflow for my fullstack team. Include local setup, review gates, automated checks, release steps, and rollback planning.

output_examples.input: Plan a fullstack application for a subscription dashboard.
output: Recommended stack with frontend, API, database, authentication, and deployment choices.
Architecture notes that explain major tradeoffs and operational risks.
A setup checklist for dependencies, environment files, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: Review an existing repository before a release.
output: A concise review of workflow readiness, missing checks, and documentation gaps.
Suggested quality gates for tests, linting, builds, and dependency review.
Follow-up actions ordered by release risk and effort.

best_practices: Review generated stack recommendations against your product requirements and team experience.
Run helper scripts only on intended project paths and inspect outputs before acting on them.
Treat deployment examples as templates that need environment-specific review and approval.
anti_patterns: Do not assume the helper scripts perform complete security, performance, or architecture analysis.
Do not run deployment commands from examples without checking cluster, account, and namespace context.
Do not copy environment files into production workflows without secret handling and access controls.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps plan and review fullstack web applications using modern JavaScript, API, database, and deployment practices.

faq.question: Does it create a full application automatically?
faq.answer: No. The included scripts are lightweight helpers and do not generate a complete production application.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Are the scripts safe to run?
faq.answer: They are simple local scripts, but the output option can overwrite files if given an unsafe path.

faq.question: What should I review before using command examples?
faq.answer: Check the current repository, package manager, cloud account, deployment target, and environment variables first.

faq.question: Who should use this skill?
faq.answer: It is most useful for developers, technical leads, and managers planning fullstack application workflows.
